scope: Public development measurements with single implementer spot judgments (not held-out accuracy); "published" holds the owner-run aggregate calibration that chose the 2026-10-16 defaults.

source.dataset: cmlarsen/fiction-baseline export at b464cac (EXTRACTOR_VERSION 1), 210 units, 71 author units
source.tool: writemorebetter tier3 --pacing at 8e2e228 (thresholds swept; minimumParagraphs 3, moreThanWords 400)
source.scope: whole units pooled per author, and chapter windows (scene-break split, target 2,000-6,000 words: closed after reaching 6,000 or at a scene break past 3,000; short tails merged); author-weighted
source.method: eligibleParagraphSignals: weighted percentiles over paragraphs with no speech and at least one counted word, each weighted 1 / (its author's eligible paragraphs); chapter shares weight each window 1 / (its author's windows); authorsWithRunsPercent counts authors with a run in any whole unit. Aggregate numbers only.
